input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: Container restarted three times mid-solve (uptime reset to 0, background jobs killed); the run resumed each time from 4b's per-stage cache. Memory was not the cause (peak about 1.2 GB of 16 GB).
integrity_issues: A 7.5 mm pilot (F1, F9) ran after the predictions were written but before they were committed; it is disclosed in LOG.md and README and the predictions were not edited. The post hoc lattice-profile diagnostic was added after seed-0 results were read and is labelled post hoc.

doc_friction.issue: Long jobs: the guidance covers the 2 h background limit but not container restarts, which hit this run three times in about 2.5 h; a per-stage cache (as 3e/4a/4b have) was what saved it. Worth saying 'make multi-hour solves resumable per stage' explicitly.

4a's chain cache is gitignored, so a code-path reproduction could only be checked against printed end states, and rounding-level path sensitivity made a 1e-4 reproduction tolerance unreachable (O2); registering such a check should compare energies of the same state, not re-solved chains.

deviations.why: Landing step 2 (land other open research PRs first): the only two were live claims under 1 h old, so I left them as pick_track.py advised.

notes: Milestone 4b of hanger-codesign: orthotropic triangle element (lattice-calibrated hinge weights, EA1/EA2). Against Petrak et al. (2021)'s nine measured wovens: RMSE 0.161, bias +0.152, r 0.919 versus the isotropic 0.148/+0.143/0.965; 2 of 9 predictions held. Local checks: test_m4b (7), test_m4a, test_m3, test_m3d pass; research/_homepage/build.py ok; check_md_links, check_posts, research_live_links ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a PhD student implementing and verifying an orthotropic discrete-shell element, running 47 chains and writing up: about two working days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
